segments.name: Omnichannel Retailer
segments.description: An omnichannel pet retailer selling pet food, supplies, companion animals and services to pet parents through pet care centers and online channels.
segments.evidence: Petco derives substantially all of its revenue in North America and manages its business activities on a consolidated basis, resulting in a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Pet parents pay the company for pet food, supplies, companion animals and services bought through pet care centers and online channels.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company operates as an omnichannel retailer designed to sell pet food, supplies and companion animals, and services to pet parents across pet care center and online channels.
